mapper.select: SELECT enrollments.id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(day_of_week, start_period, '-', end_period) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, courses.credits, enrollments.status FROM enrollments JOIN lectures ON enrollments.lecture_id = lectures.id JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN users ON lectures.professor_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id WHERE enrollments.student_id = #{studentId} AND semesters.academic_year = #{year} AND semesters.term = IF(#{semester} = 1, 'FIRST', 'SECOND')

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(courses.credits), 0) FROM enrollments JOIN lectures ON enrollments.lecture_id = lectures.id JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id WHERE enrollments.student_id = #{studentId} AND semesters.academic_year = #{year} AND semesters.term = IF(#{semester} = 1, 'FIRST', 'SECOND') AND enrollments.status != 'DROPPED'
